title: Listen to Radio Andy’s ‘Spa Weekend Cast Event’ With Leslie Mann, Isla Fisher, and More
summary: The stars of 'Spa Weekend' join the Smith Sisters to share hilarious behind-the-scenes stories and more on Radio Andy.
body_markdown:
Celebrate the release of *Spa Weekend* with an exclusive SiriusXM cast event featuring Leslie Mann, Isla Fisher, Anna Faris, and Adam Demos.


[Spa Weekend Cast Event Hosted by the Smith Sisters Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogSpaWeekendCastEvent)


During the special, the stars join[Smith Sisters Live on Radio Andy](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/smith-sisters-live) to go behind the scenes of the new comedy, from filming some of its wildest scenes in Australia to developing the cast’s onscreen chemistry.


- **Related:[‘The Invite’ Cast Event with Olivia Wilde, Seth Rogen, and More Stars](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/olivia-wilde-the-invite-cast-event)**


They also get personal about family, friendships, self-care, and their lives away from the set.


Stream[Radio Andy](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/radio-andy) ‘s full *Spa Weekend* *Cast Event* on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogSpaWeekendCastEvent) , and watch an exclusive clip from the special above now.


### **Leslie Mann Recalls Nikki Glaser Babysitting Iris Apatow**


While discussing questionable babysitting experiences, Mann recalls when comedian Nikki Glaser babysat her and Judd Apatow’s daughters.


Mann remembers looking outside during a gathering and spotting a young Iris Apatow walking around near the pool — without Glaser nearby.


“I was like, ‘Oh my God,’” Mann said, before joking that Glaser may have been busy working on her stand-up set.


### **Anna Faris Opens Up About Perimenopause and Depression**


Faris gets candid about experiencing depression around age 45 as she entered perimenopause.


“I found myself in just this low-grade depression for quite a long time,” Faris said. “Maybe it was even more severe than low-grade at times.”


Faris also discusses hormone patches, getting older, and how her outlook has changed, adding, “I feel so much happier.”


### **Leslie Mann on Maude and Iris Apatow’s Relationship**


Mann also reveals that her daughters weren’t always as close as they are today.


“Iris liked Maude, but Maude didn’t like Iris until Maude was around 18,” Mann said.


Mann explains that Maude initially struggled with having a younger sister who suddenly received so much attention. Today, however, she says Maude and Iris are best friends.


### **Anna Faris on Filming *Spa Weekend* After Losing Her Home**


Faris also reflects on beginning *Spa Weekend* just weeks after her home burned down in the Palisades.


“We didn’t have suitcases, we had nothing,” Faris said.


Filming in Australia’s Gold Coast gave Faris and her son Jack a welcome change during an extraordinarily difficult period.


“I needed to laugh,” Faris said. “To see my kid so happy, that meant the world.”


### **Go Behind the Scenes of *Spa Weekend***


The cast also shares stories about the physical comedy involved in making the movie — including Mann getting bitten by fire ants and injured by a goat — and Fisher reveals some of the jokes and improvised material that didn’t make the final cut.
